Evidence/VIS-FINDEX-SAMPLE-SUPPORT
Evidence record

How many respondents answered each Findex question

What does this evidence establish?

Weighted estimates for the 2021 wave have not yet been produced, so no values are shown. When they are published, each will be accompanied by the number of respondents who gave a valid answer, the number of missing or invalid answers, and a note where a question was asked only of a sub-group; these counts describe the sample and are not population estimates.

What does it measure?

Counts of respondents in the Yemen Findex 2021 sample who gave valid, missing or invalid answers to each question, and the sub-group each question applies to; these describe the sample, not the adult population.

Who or what does it apply to?

Valid, missing or invalid responses and the conditional sub-populations in the Findex data examined; sample-support information, not population estimates.

When was it measured or observed?

2021 Findex wave; Yemen fieldwork November 2022 to January 2023

How current is it?

No values are shown yet. When they are produced, they will refer to the 2021 Findex wave, with Yemen fieldwork from November 2022 to January 2023, the latest wave available for Yemen.

What this evidence does not establish

Raw case percentages are not population prevalence rates, and indicators are not ranked by them.
